## Counts (endorsed rows)
- Headline claims: 39. Clashes: 0.
- Joint claims: 4 (C5, C6, C19, C41).
- Claims in at least one relation: 18 (46.2%); relations 19 (14 covers, 5 backs).
- Candidates: findings 52 (52/0); transformations 4 (4/0); claims 41 (39/2); relations 21 (19/2).

## Joint claims
- C5: N service engagement trend (F21); Q advocacy and system change (F31, F35). Confirm.
- C6: N reductions while in treatment, 6 of 12 and 2 of 9 (F17, F18); Q improved access and outcomes (F35). Confirm.
- C19: N baseline CMF needs (F7-F11); Q grief after removal (F22). Confirm.
- C41: N reductions in drinking and drug use (F17, F18); Q support types (F31, F34, F38, F40, F43, F44). Expand.

## Points to check
1. C12 (confidence, self-worth) vs F14 (CMF self-esteem mixed: 44% up, 40% down): not linked by the authors, kept out of rests_on; possible note on discord.
2. C40: C11 read as a rule-2 summary of C7-C10; the alternative (rule 11, adding p.59 to C7-C10) leaves joint counts unchanged.
3. C41: rule 8 through F17, F18; if read as an illustration without findings, rests_on is empty and joint claims fall to 3.
4. C6: no association test is reported; "associated" rests on counts of women in treatment.
5. C3 empty (F6 candidate); C37's replication benefit has no finding.
